column3: Close to the Hebrew; “call out against it the proclamation” is rendered “preach to it the message.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a city great to God” is rendered “an exceedingly great city,” and NKJV adds “in extent.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a journey of one day” is rendered “on the first day’s walk.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let them not graze” is rendered “do not let them eat.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in their palms” is rendered “in his hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the evil” is rendered “the disaster.”
